## Writer constraints

- Load `no-slop-copy`.
- Do not invent prices, stock, warranty years, excluded states, hours, or installer maps.
- Capacity range and series list come from **our catalog / brand-facts**, not from a competitor’s 9–24k grid.
- DIY vs pro line required when the SERP mixes pre-charged DIY systems with licensed-startup equipment (Lennox and Trane are licensed-install).
- Multi-zone outdoor capacity is not the sum of indoor nameplates.
- Sizing copy is a starting point, not a stamped load calc. Sq ft table only if brand-facts supplied bands.
- Collection first screen = range + filter + phone. Definition waits for an H2.
- Collection install section = BOM, not attach-poetry.
